attempts.text:
Car2 cannot help: both roads out of Shivapuri hospital are cut, so Shivapuri is isolated. Car1 does every trip, and every load is dropped at Galchhi shelter. Each trip therefore starts and ends at Galchhi.

**Shortest driving times from Galchhi:**

| Location | Route | Minutes |
|---|---|---|
| Naukunda | direct | 10 |
| Gosaikunda | via Naukunda | 22 |
| Belkot | direct | 23 |
| Kalika | via Belkot | 32 |
| Likhu | via Belkot and Kalika | 52 |
| Thakre | via Likhu | 70 |

**Trips (car1 carries at most 4 people):**

| Trip | Who | Round trip (min) | Penalty avoided |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4 children from Gosaikunda | 44 | 240 |
| 2 | Elderly widow from Naukunda, then 2 adults and 1 elderly from Gosaikunda | 44 | 140 |
| 3 | 4 elderly from Belkot | 46 | 200 |
| 4 | 3 elderly and 1 injured from Likhu | 104 | 230 |
| 5 | 4 adults from Kalika | 64 | 80 |

**Deferred:**
- **Thakre injured woman:** a separate trip takes 140 minutes, which is more than her penalty of 80. Fitting her into the Likhu trip would add 36 minutes and leave one Likhu elderly person behind (penalty 50), for an extra 86. Deferring her (80) is cheaper.
- **2 Kalika adults:** a sixth trip would take 64 minutes, which is more than their combined penalty of 40.

- Driving: 44 + 44 + 46 + 104 + 64 = 302 minutes
- Penalties: 80 (Thakre injured) + 40 (2 Kalika adults) = 120
